title: Identifying Effective Strategies in Prompt Evolution for Stress and Emotion Prediction
abstract: arXiv:2610.21407v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: Early stress detection and risk prediction are crucial for timely mental health assessment and support. While large language models have recently shown promise for social media stress prediction, relying on accuracy can obscure false positives. Also, prompt revisions yield inconsistent gains across models and tasks, with unclear links to strategy combinations and instruction changes. By comparing six methods on social media stress and emotion data across two model sizes, we found that GEPA and its extension combining instructions from two prompts (GEPA+merge) improved prediction over initial prompts in several settings. We also identified five prompting strategies associated with development gains. These strategies included directing attention to emotional evidence, distinguishing current from past distress, illustrating indirect cues, requiring emotional context, and guiding label selection. translated_title: 识别提示词演化中用于压力与情绪预测的有效策略
translated_abstract: 早期压力检测与风险预测对于及时进行心理健康评估与提供支持至关重要。尽管大型语言模型近来在社交媒体压力预测方面展现出潜力，但仅依赖准确率可能会掩盖假阳性问题。此外，提示词的修订在不同模型和任务上带来的收益并不一致，其与策略组合及指令变化之间的联系也不明确。通过在两种不同规模的模型上，针对社交媒体压力与情绪数据比较六种方法，我们发现GEPA及其结合两个提示词指令的扩展方法（GEPA+merge）在多种设置下相比初始提示词提升了预测效果。我们还识别出与开发阶段收益相关的五种提示策略，这些策略包括：引导关注情绪证据、区分当前与过去的痛苦状态、示例说明间接线索、要求提供情绪背景，以及指导标签选择。此外，我们记录了四项观察发现……
tldr: 本研究系统比较了六种提示词优化方法，发现GEPA及其GEPA+merge扩展方法能显著提升大语言模型在社交媒体压力与情绪预测中的表现，并总结出五种有效的提示策略。
en_tdlr: This study systematically compares six prompt optimization methods, showing that GEPA and its GEPA+merge extension improve LLM-based stress and emotion prediction on social media, and identifies five effective prompting strategies.
